title: Detect letterbox and pillarbox bars
summary: Finds solid or blurred-fill bars on each frame edge of a video and reports their size in source pixels, colour, style and the content rectangle, as a detection envelope.
description: Scans rows and columns inwards from each edge of sampled frames. Solid bars are lines whose pixels stay within a colour tolerance of the bar colour; static titles inside a bar are allowed when the bar resumes after them. Blurred-fill bars (a blurred copy of the video behind a fitted clip) are low-gradient edge regions that change over time. Thickness uses a low percentile across frames so dark scenes do not widen the bar.

side_effects: runs ffprobe and ffmpeg as subprocesses to decode the input video

review.notes: pytest passed on synthetic fixtures with known ground truth (Python 3.13, numpy 2.x, jsonschema 4.x) including a lossless FFV1 command-line round trip with ffmpeg 6.1.
